source_brief_reference: Create a short educational explainer video about how an AI production pipeline checks generated frames before assembly. The video should be clear, practical, and suitable for beginners.
narrative_goal: a short educational explainer video about how an AI production pipeline checks generated frames before assembly

three_act.act_1: Setup — introduce the problem and context
three_act.act_2: Confrontation — explore the pipeline steps and challenges
three_act.act_3: Resolution — show successful resolution and conclusion

intended_emotional_arc: Curiosity -> Understanding -> Confidence in AI pipeline quality assurance
intended_informational_arc: Problem introduction -> Pipeline explanation -> QA mechanism -> Defect resolution -> Value reinforcement
